body.name: \(\mathfrak C_{\mathrm H}\)
body.def: The class of two-wave policy-design problems with terminal action \(\gamma\in\Gamma_{\mathrm H}\), local state \(h\in\mathcal U_{\mathrm H}\), and criterion \(W_{\mathrm H}(h,\gamma)\) such that \(W_{\mathrm H}\) is twice continuously differentiable in \(\gamma\) on a relative neighborhood of its optimizer graph, \(\operatorname*{argmax}_{\gamma\in\Gamma_{\mathrm H}}W_{\mathrm H}(h,\gamma)\) is a singleton contained in \(\operatorname{relint}(\Gamma_{\mathrm H})\) for every \(h\in\mathcal U_{\mathrm H}\), and \(-\nabla_{\gamma}^2W_{\mathrm H}(h,\gamma)\succeq c_{\mathrm H}I_{s_{\mathrm H}}\) on that neighborhood.
